snippet.title: Zombie Rush: Survival — Map 2 Cinematic Trailer | Industrial District
snippet.description:
The Industrial District is overrun. Your squad is the survivors’ last chance.

Watch the Map 2 cinematic trailer for Zombie Rush: Survival, featuring SWAT combat, dangerous gas zones, gate choices, weapon rewards, and a terrifying Mutant encounter.

Upgrade your firepower with machine guns, RPGs, and turret kits. Fight through the infected, protect your squad, and get the survivors to safety.

CHOOSE. UPGRADE. SURVIVE.
Bring them home.

Which weapon would you take into the Industrial District? Tell us in the comments.

Subscribe for more gameplay, trailers, and development updates.

This trailer features cinematic sequences and staged gameplay demonstrations.

#ZombieRushSurvival #ZombieGame #GameTrailer
